summary: Adds a signed PostgreSQL schema-epoch bridge whose owner job stops before explicit-context enforcement while application startup verifies either side of the policy cutover.

instructions: Deploy the independently signed bridge release and let its separately credentialed owner job apply exactly through migration 1700000000131 before starting bridge application replicas.
Keep the bridge and previous qualified release for the complete 28-day fallback interval; only the later owner-controlled release may apply migration 1700000000132.

configuration: No operator migration-skip or schema-epoch selector is added. The application verify role and owner migration ceiling are immutable signed manifest data.

notes: The bridge owner entrypoint can execute the already introduced release-effect migration 1700000000131 but filters TypeORM before migration 1700000000132.
The bridge accepts only exact migration-ledger inventories through 1700000000131 with the released legacy policy or through 1700000000132 with attested explicit-context policies.

security: Application startup rejects apply mode for pooled PostgreSQL before schema repair, synchronization or connection-owned migration work.
The bounded owner path cannot run synchronize, migration-ledger baselining, policy repair, critical-schema repair, RBAC seeding or legacy projection side effects.

The signed candidate receipt binds the manifest checksum and exact accepted epochs; candidate image qualification verifies the same bytes at both backend runtime and published shared-package locations.
knownLimitations: Cloud rollout remains responsible for verifying the signed receipt and exact source/image/chart subjects before selecting the bridge; this OSS release does not implement a provider controller.
rollback: Before migration 1700000000132, restore the preceding qualified runtime while preserving migration 1700000000131 and its additive settlement tables.
After migration 1700000000132, use the qualified pre-upgrade backup and compatible runtime; do not edit the TypeORM ledger or recreate permissive policies in place.
validation: Focused tests prove application apply rejection, the exact owner ceiling, absence of owner repair side effects, exact pre/post ledger acceptance and rejection of malformed or unexpected epochs.

PostgreSQL integration verifies the released legacy policy remains valid before the real 1700000000132 enforcement migration and the explicit-context profile afterward; package, Helm and signed-candidate contracts verify immutable manifest delivery.
